name.description: Shown on the stage intro screen.

background.description: Asset id of the scrolling background.

music.description: Asset id of the stage music.

seed.description: Seeds roster picks and random heights so a level plays the same every run. Leave out for a random seed.

waves.description: Played in order. An empty list goes straight to the terrain and boss.

terrain.description: Scrolling blocks. null for an open-space level.

boss.description: Comes in once every wave is cleared. null ends the level when the last wave is cleared.

roster.description: Enemy id (a key of enemies.json) to weight. Each formation slot picks one enemy by weight. Weights are normalised, so they need not add up to 1.

y.description: Height of the formation's anchor: world units (0 = top, 1080 = bottom), "center", or "random" (kept clear of the edges).

delay.description: Seconds after the previous wave started, or after it was cleared when waitForClear is true.

repeat.description: How many times the formation is sent.

startAt.description: Seconds after the level starts when the first column enters on the right.

tiles.description: One character per tile kind. A space is always empty.

map.description: Top row first. Every row has the same length.

solid.description: Solid tiles stop missiles. Non-solid tiles (spikes, gas) only hurt on contact.

health.description: Leave out for an indestructible tile.

id.description: A key of bosses in enemies.json.

delay.description: Seconds after the last wave is cleared.
